digest.component_or_area: plan-review & code-review documentation and CLI/MCP explain interface
propositions: Authors lack a concise, discoverable on-ramp explaining how to write a plan that passes the plan-review gate and code that passes the code-review (LLM-Review + Verified) gate.

The existing material (plan-review-gate.md and generated criterion registry) does not serve as author-facing documentation, and AGENTS.md misdirects authors to the criterion registry for the description template.
The rebar explain CLI and MCP explain_criterion tool must support author-guide names (rebar explain plan, rebar explain review) in addition to criterion IDs via a single registry lookup.
New prose on-ramp docs must be distinct from and not interfere with the auto-generated criterion registry, which remains the source of truth for reviewers.
All top-level docs/*.md files must be linked from docs/README.md to satisfy the docs-index CI gate.
